web.description:
# C_ChatInfo.SendAddonMessage
## Message throttling
Communications on all chat types are subject to a per-prefix throttle.

## Libraries
- [ChatThrottleLib](https://www.wowace.com/projects/chatthrottlelib) ( [docs](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/ChatThrottleLib), [stats](https://www.townlong-yak.com/globe/wut/#q:ChatThrottleLib))
